title: Global-from-Local Restart in Lean 4: Conditional Continuation Theorem Prohibiting Finite-Time Termination Under Uniform Ceiling Bounds
description: Standalone zero-sorry Lean 4 formalization (`Continuation.lean`, `GlobalFromLocalRestart.lean`) proving `Continuation.no_finite_last_time_of_restart`: an abstract continuation theorem showing that any evolution system satisfying local existence with uniform step size below a ceiling, a priori ceiling preservation, and uniqueness cannot terminate at a finite maximal time T*. Proves the abstract conditional continuation lemma in Lean 4 with zero sorry; explicitly states that applying it to 3D Navier-Stokes requires supplying the a priori ceiling hypothesis independently.
